0\. Inicialización Obligatoria en PowerShell (Carga del Módulo de Exchange) 

```
Add-PSSnapin Microsoft.Exchange.Management.PowerShell.SnapIn -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
```

![][image1]

1\. Identificación del Servidor, Roles y Software 

* Consultar versión build exacta y roles de Exchange (Mailbox/ClientAccess)

```
Get-ExchangeServer -Identity VM-MARANDU | Select-Object Name, AdminDisplayVersion, ServerRole
```

![][image2]

* Verificar estado del servicio Health Manager (MSExchangeHM)

```
Get-Service MSExchangeHM
```

![][image3]

* Inventario completo de aplicaciones instaladas en el registro (32 y 64 bits)

```
Get-ItemProperty HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*, HKLM:\Software\Wow6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\* | 
    Select-Object DisplayName, DisplayVersion, Publisher | 
    Where-Object { $_.DisplayName -ne $null } | Sort-Object DisplayName
```

![][image4]  
![][image5]

2\. Diagnóstico de Configuración de Dominios y Políticas de Correo 

* Consultar dominios aceptados (para verificar Authoritative vs InternalRelay)

```
Get-AcceptedDomain | Select-Object Name, DomainName, DomainType, Default | Format-Table -AutoSize
```

![][image6]

* Consultar política de direcciones de correo (dirección SMTP primaria vs secundarios)

```
Get-EmailAddressPolicy | Select-Object Name, Priority, Enabled, EnabledEmailAddressTemplates | Format-Table -AutoSize
```

![][image7]

3\. Auditoría de Cambios y Registro de Eventos (Últimos 90 Días) 

* Consulta a AdminAuditLog de Exchange (Busca ejecuciones de Set-AcceptedDomain)

```
Search-AdminAuditLog -Cmdlets Set-AcceptedDomain, Set-EmailAddressPolicy -StartDate (Get-Date).AddDays(-90) -EndDate (Get-Date) | 
    ForEach-Object {
        [PSCustomObject]@{
            Fecha      = $_.RunDate
            Usuario    = $_.Caller
            Cmdlet     = $_.CmdletName
            Objeto     = $_.ObjectModified
            Parametros = ($_.CmdletParameters | ForEach-Object { "$($_.Name)=$($_.Value)" }) -join " | "
        }
    } | Format-Table -AutoSize
```

![][image8]

* Consulta al Event Viewer de Windows (Canal MSExchange Management)

```
Get-WinEvent -LogName "MSExchange Management" -MaxEvents 500 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | 
    Where-Object { $_.Message -like "*Set-AcceptedDomain*" -or $_.Message -like "*cajaande.gov.py*" } | 
    Select-Object TimeCreated, @{N="Usuario";E={$_.Properties[2].Value}}, @{N="Comando";E={$_.Message}} | 
    Format-List
```

![][image9]

4\. Medición del Impacto y Cuantificación de Rebotes (Message Tracking Log) 

* Conteo diario de fallos de entrega (FAIL) en los últimos 30 días

```
Get-MessageTrackingLog -EventId FAIL -Start (Get-Date).AddDays(-30) -End (Get-Date) -ResultSize Unlimited | 
    Group-Object @{E={$_.Timestamp.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd")}} | 
    Select-Object @{N="Fecha";E={$_.Name}}, @{N="Correos_Fallidos";E={$_.Count}} | 
    Sort-Object Fecha | Format-Table -AutoSize
```

![][image10]

* Muestreo de remitentes externos, destinatarios y motivos de rebote hacia @cajaande.gov.py

```
Get-MessageTrackingLog -EventId FAIL -Start (Get-Date).AddDays(-30) -End (Get-Date) -ResultSize 200 | 
    Where-Object { $_.Recipients -like "*@cajaande.gov.py*" } | 
    Select-Object Timestamp, Sender, @{N="Destinatario";E={$_.Recipients -join ";"}}, MessageSubject, @{N="Motivo_Error";E={$_.RecipientStatus -join ";"}} | 
    Format-Table -AutoSize
```

![][image11]  
![][image12]

* Parámetros de retención del log de transporte en el servidor

```
Get-TransportService VM-MARANDU | Select-Object Name, MessageTrackingLogMaxAge, MessageTrackingLogMaxDirectorySize
```

![][image13]

REMEDIACIÓN

```
Set-AcceptedDomain -Identity "Caja Ande" -DomainType Authoritative
```
